records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Bright Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Following up on your notification badge
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge count that won't clear -- your ticket is still open and we're looking into it, and I'll come back to you as soon as I have something concrete.

In the meantime, your first project is set up, which is the main thing. Tasks tend to get more useful once a second person is in there with you, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever next step is most useful for Bright Logistics.

Best,
Chidi
